name: Emami Paper Mills Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1981, Emami Paper Mills Ltd manufactures writing and printing paper, newsprint, and also packaging boards[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
EPML, part of Emami Group, manufactures newsprint, writing and printing paper, and Multilayer Coated Board. It is India's largest newsprint producer and the only manufacturer in Eastern India.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.95 times its book value
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 20.9%
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 4.94% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 12.3% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
